validity_findings: VF-01: All frozen measurement validity gates (V1 code identity, V2 controls 15/15 PASS, V3 inventory 20/20 seeds HTTP 200, V4 frame fidelity 20 hosts/556 DEEP items/hash match, V5 census completeness 556/556 fetched) passed. The measurement transaction is valid (status=COMPLETE) and the FALSIFIES outcome is a bounded scientific negative, not an infrastructure failure (result.json VN-1).

VF-02: The frozen entry-point executability defect class from the parent (AUDIT-VF-05: TypeError on controls_seen=None, KeyError 'live') is closed. The reconstructed module executed --stage controls/inventory/structural/discovery to completion (exit 0) on the real pool, and V1 bound the executed code identity (sha256 b9b2efdc...). Confirmed by provenance.json code_identity.v1_gate=PASS and the three audit repairs confirmed present.

VF-03: Construct degeneracy (prereg section 14.1, result.json VN-3): 'state-carrying' includes theme chrome inputs (mdBook 'searchbar', Sphinx/Sphinx-RTD 'q'). This was disclosed pre-hoc and NOT narrowed post-hoc. The zero discovery result (0/208) holds even with the inflated construct; a chrome-stripped construct would only reduce the semantic weight of the denominator, not change the decision.

VF-04: Empirical tilt (prereg section 14.2, result.json VN-4, design_review nonblocking finding 1): Hosts with static named search forms (mdBook, Sphinx, Sphinx-RTD) expose shallow site indexes (version roots only); hosts with deep-complete static indexes (Docusaurus, Hugo, Jekyll, MkDocs Material, Astro/Starlight) carry no named DEEP controls on this frame. The measured zero is consistent with this tilt. The FALSIFIES is correctly bounded to: credential-free GET-only stdlib-HTTP substrate, frozen 20-host pool, frozen 556-item frame, five frozen channels, K=3. It is NOT a proof that no site on the credential-free Web can enumerate deep content (the in-substrate positive pole docs.djangoproject.com cited at prereg 11e was deliberately excluded from the frozen frame).

VF-05: ON_SITE_SEARCH coverage gap (prereg 14.6, result.json VN-5): All 208 slug-query probes returned HTTP 200 but result pages contained no static <a> links (JS-rendered). Recorded as a disclosed coverage gap of the static-HTTP instrument, not as a null success. This is a validity boundary of the frozen mandate, not a measurement defect.

VF-06: docs.readthedocs.io frame property (result.json VN-7): The parent BFS followed the seed redirect (docs.readthedocs.io -> docs.readthedocs.com) and used final_url as link base. The 28 admitted items live on docs.readthedocs.com (different host). V7 exact-host membership semantics (frozen in spec.json V7) prevent cross-host matching; channel documents for docs.readthedocs.io contain only 1-2 URLs, none deep. Disclosed, not silently ignored.

VF-07: Single-vantage measurement (result.json VN-8, unresolved U-3): All fetches from one runner egress (no proxy rotation). Channel-document availability and liveness not re-checked from a second network vantage. Cross-vantage stationarity is a standing reproducibility caveat for this substrate class, carried to unresolved. Not a measurement invalidity for the frozen design.
VF-08: Frame staleness not a confound (result.json VN-6): 208/208 admitted item URLs were live (HTTP 200) at EXECUTE. No dead items to exclude.

VF-09: Engine distinctness (frozen V12): docs.pytest.org and docs.readthedocs.io are both Sphinx-RTD on distinct base-domain hosts. The frozen V12 rule defines engine_class = <meta name='generator'> else documented platform, with Q3 requiring >=2 distinct engine classes on distinct base-domain hosts. This is correctly applied; platform-infrastructure sharing (readthedocs.com) does not collapse engine classes under the frozen rule (result.json unresolved U-5).

VF-10: Baseline contrast properly measured (result.json metrics.baseline_B_SAME_HOST_BFS_PATH_COST): BFS path cost mean ordinal 166.0 (min 31, max 250) for 208 admitted items vs discovery 0/208 at charged cost <=K=3. The contrast is discriminating and measured in-frame.
baseline_findings: BF-01: B-SAME-HOST-BFS-PATH-COST (primary comparator measured in-frame): Per admitted DEEP item, the 1-based BFS discovery/fetch ordinal from the bound frame (requests column) is the a-priori acquisition path the O(1) claim must beat. Measured: 208/208 items within budget; ordinal mean 166.0. Discovery reached 0/208 at charged <=3. The contrast is directly identifiable and measured in the same frame.

BF-02: B-PERSISTED-PATH-REACQUISITION (inherited RACQ_PATH ~hop+1 from EXP-FRONTIER-37950626378): Carried as inherited context only, labeled not re-measured. Identifies the path-bound cost discovery must undercut. Consistent with BFS path cost measurement.

BF-04: Null controls certify instrument dynamic range: NC_BFS_CALIBRATION_FLAT (R=2.0 <= 3.0 PASS) and NC_BFS_CALIBRATION_GROWING (R=6.5 > 3.0 PASS) demonstrate the BFS census logic separates flat and growing hop-cost regimes. claim_ceiling: On the credential-free GET-only stdlib-HTTP substrate, over the frozen 20-host pool and the bound 556-item DEEP frame (hop 3..6) from EXP-FRONTIER-38164611798, with the five frozen site-native discovery channels (ROBOTS_SITEMAP, SITEMAP_XML, ON_SITE_SEARCH, RSS_ATOM, JSON_LD) at charged protocol cost <= K=3 fresh-agent GETs: zero of three DEEP-admitting engines (mdBook n=13, Sphinx n=8, Sphinx-RTD n=187) reach a discovery-reachable fraction >= 0.50. The FALSIFIES is an engine-stratified bounded negative (frozen decision rule G6). It does NOT generalize to: (a) JS/browser substrates, (b) pools containing hosts with deep-complete static indexes AND named deep controls (e.g., the in-substrate positive pole docs.djangoproject.com cited at prereg 11e, deliberately excluded from this frame), (c) channels beyond the five frozen ones, (d) credentialed or POST/PUT substrates. The zero result holds even with the construct-degenerate 'state-carrying' definition (includes theme chrome). Cross-vantage stationarity untested (single runner egress).

unresolved: U-1: Whether a JS-executing substrate (browser-rendered search results) would change ON_SITE_SEARCH coverage — out of the frozen mandate's credential-free static-HTTP scope; remains untested (result.json U-1, prereg 14.6).

U-2: Whether a pool rebuilt from this Q1 census to select hosts with the deep-complete-static-index × named-deep-controls conjunction (e.g., the prereg 11e in-substrate positive pole docs.djangoproject.com) would reach the 0.50 threshold. SUPPORTS remains a real but unmeasured state of the world for this instrument on a different frame (result.json U-2).

U-3: Cross-vantage stationarity of channel documents (egress IP/ASN effects) was not measured; a single-vantage result is the standing reproducibility caveat for this substrate class (result.json VN-8, U-3).

U-4: A chrome/construct split (distribution of named-control types, e.g., searchbar vs q vs content form fields, per admitted item) was not recorded by the frozen module (it counts controls, not their names); a secondary split would require a new measurement outside the frozen scope (result.json U-4).

U-5: docs.readthedocs.io and docs.pytest.org are both Sphinx-RTD on distinct base-domain hosts but share the readthedocs.com platform infrastructure. 'Distinct engines' per frozen V12 means distinct engine classes on distinct base-domain hosts, not necessarily independent server origins (result.json U-5).

U-6: The ON_SITE_SEARCH channel's frozen semantics query the exact item slug via the seed-HTML form finder. The observed JS-rendered results are a known static-HTTP boundary; whether alternative query formulations (title, heading text, URL patterns) would yield static links is untested and outside the frozen design.
